programs.title: Save My Skin
programs.desc: The skin on Yvonne's hands and feet is so thick, her husband uses dangerous measures to remove it; Leonie has big keloids on both ears; Matt's Psoriasis is so severe, an infection nearly killed him; and Neville has a mystery growth on his shin.

programs.desc: Lisa has been suffering with dark, wart like lesions for almost three decades; it's a severe case of seborrheic keratosis; Dawn's desperate to get rid of her big lipoma and inject the fun back into her life.

programs.title: Save My Skin
programs.desc: For six years, the big lump on Paul's neck has been steadily growing and now he says it's like having a second head; he's desperate for Dr Emma's help.

programs.title: One Day in My Body
programs.desc: There are only two foods that won't send Caroline into anaphylaxis; touching almost anything causes Ariana's butterfly skin to blister and tear; Aleazia's cystic hygroma caused his jaw and tongue to swell, permanently freezing his mouth open.

programs.sub_title: Walk the Walk, Talk the Talk
